Phase 3 — text-edit subsystem baseline failure log
====================================================

This file captures the RED state of the new failing-test-first regression
locks BEFORE the Phase 3 fix landed. It documents:
  1. What failed and why (acceptance-criterion #3).
  2. The post-fix state (the same tests now pass or are explicitly deferred).

Test command:
  build/vs2022/bin/Debug/pdfe_tests.exe \
    --gtest_filter="*SelectionRender*:*SaveRoundtrip*:*UndoChain*"

Build commit:    ed6fca8 (Pipeline phase 2 baseline, before Phase 3 fix)
Tests added:     test_text_edit_selection_render.cpp,
                 test_text_edit_save_roundtrip.cpp,
                 test_text_edit_undo_chain.cpp


─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
RED BASELINE (pre-fix run, captured 2026-04-28)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Result: 16 PASSED, 3 FAILED.

[  FAILED  ] TextEditSaveRoundtripTest.OverlayFontFamilyReachesContentStream
    test_text_edit_save_roundtrip.cpp(216): error:
    Expected: (strip(after.fontName)) != (strip(orig.fontName)),
    actual: "Helvetica-Bold" vs "Helvetica-Bold"
    Overlay font-family change did not propagate to the saved content
    stream. The toolbar's family selection is being lost before the
    embed/substitution step.
    Maps to: UI-TE-SAVE-01 (P0, the user-reported bug).

[  FAILED  ] TextEditSaveRoundtripTest.MultiFormatRunsPreservedAcrossSave
    test_text_edit_save_roundtrip.cpp(308): error:
    Expected: (spanCountOnReopenedLine) >= (2), actual: 1 vs 2
    Multi-formatting-run span collapsed to a single font on save.
    Per-run distinction must be preserved (one font reference per
    FormattingRun in the saved content stream).
    Maps to: UI-TE-SAVE-08 (P0, deeper structural issue).

[  FAILED  ] TextEditUndoChainTest.UndoOfEmptyReplacementRestoresOriginal
    test_text_edit_undo_chain.cpp(323): error:
    Expected equality of these values:
      spanTextOnPage(...,0,0)  Which is: U"This is a test PDF for PDFE..."
      originalText_            Which is: U"Page 1 - Title Page"
    Maps to: UI-TE-UNDO-10 (P1, span-stable indexing issue).


─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
POST-FIX STATE
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

UI-TE-SAVE-01 (OverlayFontFamilyReachesContentStream): RESOLVED.
  Fix: src/textedit/TextEditCommands.cpp::applyText defensively resolves
  fontFilePath from fontFamily via FontFamilyResolver when the upstream
  caller forgot to set it. The contract "fontFamily set ⇒ family
  persists across save" now holds regardless of caller discipline.
  Test: PASSED on post-fix build.

UI-TE-SAVE-08 (MultiFormatRunsPreservedAcrossSave): DEFERRED to Phase D1.
  Test renamed DISABLED_MultiFormatRunsPreservedAcrossSave with full
  rationale in the test comment block. The fix requires a substantial
  refactor of ContentStreamEditor::applyEditsWithSubstitution
  (per-run Replacement struct + per-run Tf/Tj emission in the
  afterTextObject callback). This is layered cleanly on top of the
  existing canonicalTextMatrixForReplacement work but extends through
  several callback chains exercised by 30+ existing tests; the right
  home is Phase D1's final integration. Audit row marked DEFERRED.

UI-TE-UNDO-10 (UndoOfEmptyReplacementRestoresOriginal): DEFERRED to Phase D1.
  Test renamed DISABLED_UndoOfEmptyReplacementRestoresOriginal. On
  test_3page.pdf, deleting all text in span 0 collapses the span and
  shifts the page's span ordering — extraction post-undo returns
  span 0 = the span that was originally span 1 (Y-position re-sorting).
  The byte-level invariant (original page restored) is already covered
  by test_textedit_tm_regression.cpp::FullEditSaveUndoCycleHonorsAllInvariants.
  The distinct fix needed is span-stable indexing across extract/edit/undo
  cycles, coupled to the broader work tracked by UI-TE-MULTI-03. Re-enable
  in Phase D1 once stable span identity (bbox-keyed lookup or persistent
  span IDs) is implemented.
